what_it_measured.text: Effects of Casein-Derived Peptide Met-Lys-Pro on Systolic and Diastolic Blood Pressure: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel-Group Study

dose.text: Participants received either a test powder containing 100 µg of MKP or a placebo powder without MKP for 12 weeks.

endpoint.text: Blood pressure was measured by the medical staff after resting for more than 5 min and in a seated position with arms supported at the heart level.
The primary outcome was blood pressure, and SBP and DBP were measured using a sphygmomanometer (HEM-907; Omron Healthcare, Kyoto, Japan) based on the guideline JSH2019 [1].
For the primary outcome, the effect of MKP was analyzed using analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) with baseline values as covariates.

reported_results.text: As a result, SBP and DBP were significantly lower in the MKP group than in the placebo group. No adverse events associated with the MKP intake were observed.
